description: Two legacy indexes separated by a space are both applied
notes: The spec says the legacy index syntax does not support chaining, and explains that 0.0 would be read as a number literal. It doesn't say whether chaining works when whitespace keeps the steps from forming one number token. hashicorp/hcl scans .0 and .1 as two separate legacy indexes and applies both (parseExpressionTraversals in hclsyntax/parser.go).
